specific_objectives: 6.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to perform rectification of corrosion.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of mechanical cleaning and chemical conversion coating application on sample metal plates. Safety precautions: Wear PPE including gloves, goggles, and apron. Instructor supervision: Direct observation and immediate correction of technique.
intro_questions: What is the primary cause of galvanic corrosion in aircraft structures?
Name two common types of corrosion found on aluminum alloy components.
Why is early detection of corrosion critical for engine component safety?

topics: Identification of corrosion types on engine parts
Chemical cleaning agents and application methods
development.content:
Identification of corrosion types on engine parts
Mechanical removal techniques using abrasives
Chemical cleaning agents and application methods

Surface preparation standards for coating
Application of corrosion inhibitors
Passivation and conversion coating processes

Quality inspection of treated surfaces
Documentation of corrosion rectification
Precautions during final reassembly

summary_questions: Describe the correct sequence for treating pitting corrosion on a turbine blade.
What are the key differences between mechanical and chemical corrosion removal methods?
How do you verify that a chemically treated surface is ready for coating?
home_assignment_question: List the contents of the AHCP kit and explain the specific function of each item in corrosion prevention.

pft_rows.syllabus: Introduction to AHCP kit, contents of kit and their applicability on aircraft.
